Canonical OKF v0.2 specification source:
  https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/open-knowledge-format/blob/ad30107c31c06aec8a7d5636e0d1058118604e6f/SPEC.md
Pinned revision:

The AWS sample's pinned condensed reference describes OKF v0.1. This fixture adapts that project's documented real-bundle shapes: Markdown concepts, YAML frontmatter with required `type`, display metadata, nested concept paths, reserved `index.md`, and ordinary Markdown links between concepts. Business content, identifiers, and source URLs were rewritten as deterministic repository-owned test data so the E2E is offline and contains no AWS/customer data.

The fixture then applies the canonical OKF v0.2 specification for the provenance/trust/lifecycle additions exercised by #35: `sources`, `usage_window`, `generated`, `verified`, `status`, and `stale_after`. It also includes one deliberately broken link, an unknown producer metadata key, and a deprecated concept used to prove delete reconciliation.

No upstream runtime, AWS service, or network access is required by the tests.
